about: Upper limits of the bundles' sizes (tools/ci_checks.py sizes, CI). Set about 10 % above the sizes after the vias-in-3D merge and the channel export with its LTspice bench and export settings (2026-10-25: kisi.html 3.20 MB, kisi-examples.html 6.83 MB, kisi.mjs 2.54 MB; before them 2.87 / 6.50 / 2.22 MB); with accuracy and the Prepare PCB page 3.43 / 7.20 / 2.64 MB, still within. kisi.html raised to 3.54 MB for the DC IR-drop corrections (cut cells, line tracks, via contacts: 3.519 → 3.533 MB, 2026-11-06), to 3.58 MB for the power maps' rendering (interpolation, copper mask, track strokes, isolines, current arrows: 3.533 → 3.559 MB, 2026-11-09); kisi.html to 3.80 MB and kisi.mjs to 2.90 MB for the fab stackups & tolerances option (stackup templates, the comparison and tolerance band, the tolerance corners of the export: kisi.html 3.559 → 3.761 MB, kisi.mjs 2.864 MB, 2026-11-09). A change that makes a bundle larger on purpose raises the limit in the same commit.
